notes: Account: mid-market B2B search/sentiment product for e-commerce merchants. Product team owns LLM roadmap.
Hosted trial summary (3 weeks): average QPS 18, sustained QPS ~12 during business hours, observed peak burst 87 QPS (bot surge), typical concurrency 6-9 per model instance.
Token mix observed in trial: prompt tokens ~35%, generation tokens ~65%. Average tokens per call ~220 (prompt 75 / completion 145).
Latency: p50 ~120ms, p95 ~420ms on hosted API (model: Redwood-curated 13B variant for chat). They want p95 < 300ms for support workflows.
Cost sensitivity: mid-high. They prefer predictable monthly committed cost vs variable per-token billing once on Dedicated.
Use-case breakdown: support agent (priority), doc-search/semantic retrieval (embeddings), reranking for search results, on-demand summarization for tickets.
Product quote from CPO: "We like Redwood performance but need predictable unit economics and VPC/KMS for PCI-like partners."
Dedicated sizing ask: customer wants guidance for 'steady-state' and 'burst' capacity. Provided Redwood guidance scenario below.
Redwood recommended sizing (POC): target production steady-state 25 QPS with 120 QPS burst headroom. Assume avg tokens/call 220 -> steady-state tokens/sec ~5.5k.

Rough capacity estimate: 2-4 accelerator nodes (H100-class) with autoscale buffer for bursts OR 6-8 A100-80GB equivalent nodes depending on model quantization. Expect ~8-12 concurrency per GPU for 13B quantized model; larger models reduce concurrency.
Throughput forecast: steady-state 25 QPS -> ~4750 tokens/sec -> monthly ~12.3B tokens. Add burst factor and margin -> plan for 15B token/month committed (sizing tier).

POC plan: 1) Deploy Dedicated private tenancy in VPC, 2) Replay sampled production traffic from hosted trial for 72-hour soak, 3) Validate SLOs (p95 < 300ms), 4) Validate KMS + audit logs, 5) Finalize SLA and pricing.

Workload routing: want rules to route low-cost embeddings to smaller quantized variants, fall back to larger model if quality drop detected. Need Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/cache settings.
Pricing ask: committed monthly token banding + flat reserved node pricing. Asked ops: sample estimate for 15B tokens / month + 3x H100 equivalent nodes reserved.
Blockers called out by procurement: internal legal wants data residency clause for EU contracts (they sell to EU merchants); SOC2 report and KMS attestation required.
Action items: Maya to send dedicated POC SOW + pricing tiers; Jordan to prepare capacity-sizing doc + traffic replay checklist; security to provide SOC2 snapshot and KMS runbook.
